intro.text: The most powerful nation of its world, founded in the centuries after the father machine by descendants of nomads from the outskirts of Torio.

description.text: Its people resemble the Veden in their features and dark hair but have paler skin, and beards are uncommon among them.

Less than fifty miles across, it lies only a few miles from where Torio stood. It has a few cities and smaller towns, joined by hion lines that open paths through the shroud, and some cities lie on the coast.
